quests.name: Trouble with Zombies
quests.summary: The banker wants the zombie near Aldmere thinned out.
intro: The zombie beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 8 of them close to Aldmere and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Willow Logs
quests.summary: The general store keeper of Aldmere has run out of willow logs.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 16 willow logs and nobody in Aldmere has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Archery Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Aldmere to the archery shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the archery shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the barber.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Food Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the food shop keeper of Aldmere and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the food shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Aldmere Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Aldmere Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Aldmere Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Spiders
quests.summary: The magic shop keeper wants the spider near Aldmere thinned out.
intro: The spider beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 8 of them close to Aldmere and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Iron Bar
quests.summary: The clothes shop keeper of Aldmere has run out of iron bar.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 8 iron bar and nobody in Aldmere has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Staff Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Aldmere to the staff shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the staff shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the food shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Sweeping the Aldmere Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant spider out of Aldmere Sewers and tell the general store keeper.
intro: Aldmere Sewers is crawling with giant spider, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 13 of them, then let the general store keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Aldmere owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Aldmere Sewers is clearer than it was. 13 giant spider fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Velneir
quests.summary: Gather iron bar for the general store keeper, then carry a shipment to Velneir.
intro: I have an order from Velneir and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 8 iron bar, then take the packed shipment to the general store keeper there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the general store keeper in Aldmere.
From Aldmere? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Aldmere and bring back iron bar.
intro: The wilds around Aldmere need a firm hand. Start with 8 bat outside the walls, then 13 giant rat down in Aldmere Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 8 iron bar to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Aldmere for the sword shop keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the archery shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the general store keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the archery shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Aldmere Sewers (Archery Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Clear giant rat out of Aldmere Sewers and tell the fishing shop keeper.

outro: Both done? Aldmere owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Aldmere Sewers is clearer than it was. 13 giant rat fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

intro: I have an order from Velneir and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 10 big bones, then take the packed shipment to the magic shop keeper there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the magic shop keeper in Aldmere.
From Aldmere? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Aldmere and bring back willow logs.

When that is done, bring me 16 willow logs to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

Speak to the barber, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The food shop keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the armour shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the barber.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Stonejaw Depths, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Stonejaw Depths has stood against Aldmere for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the magic shop keeper, fight your way through 19 bat and end The Broodmother.
Bring 10 big bones back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Stonejaw Depths?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Aldmere: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.

quests.name: The Aldmere Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Aldmere and Velneir.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Velneir. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 19 bat near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the sword shop keeper in Aldmere.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Velneir is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Aldmere has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Aldmere
quests.summary: Find what rules Aldmere Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Plague Warden.
intro: Something rules Aldmere Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the food shop keeper what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Aldmere is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Plague Warden.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Plague Warden is dead. Aldmere Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.
